sources.title: Visas – entry regime: Ukraine
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Czech MFA Ukraine entry page says the destination state's mission is competent to communicate current entry and stay conditions; it does not state a Czech ordinary-passport visa outcome.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ke sdělování aktuálních podmínek vstupu ... je příslušný zastupitelský úřad daného státu.

sources.title: Ukraine
sources.publisher: Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs, Austria
sources.officialityEvidence: The live BMEIA Ukraine page is a travel warning and directs travellers to destination authorities; it does not map an ordinary Austrian passport to a visa route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vor Reisen in die Ukraine wird gewarnt.

sources.title: e-Visas for certain countries
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs, Defence, Development Cooperation and Foreign Trade, Luxembourg
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Luxembourg MFA traveller page names Ukraine and directs Luxembourg nationals to pre-travel e-Tourist Visa application; it conflicts with the displayed fallback but does not reconcile Ukrainian destination authority.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Luxembourg nationals ... need to apply for an "e-Tourist Visa" before their travel

unresolved.reason: Austria's current issuer guidance is a warning, not a passport-specific entry rule. The Rada decree's legal status is indeterminate; no affirmative current ordinary-passport waiver was found.
